name: Airknight Parshath
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, draw 1 card from your Deck.

name: Athena
extDescription: Each time a Fairy-Type monster is Summoned, inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Once per turn, you can send 1 Fairy-Type monster you control, except Athena, to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard, except Athena.

name: Beckoning Light
extDescription: Discard all the cards in your hand, then select a number of LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard equal to the number of cards you discarded, and add them to your hand.

name: Burial from a Different Dimension
extDescription: Select up to 3 Monster Cards that are removed from play, and return them to their owners' Graveyard.

name: Cards from the Sky
extDescription: Remove from play 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster in your hand to draw 2 cards. You cannot Special Summon or conduct your Battle Phase during the same turn you activate this card.

name: Celestial Transformation
extDescription: Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your hand. That monster's ATK is halved, and it is destroyed during the End Phase.

name: Consecrated Light
extDescription: Neither player can Normal or Special Summon DARK monsters or declare an attack with a DARK monster. This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK monster, and you take no Battle Damage from that battle.

name: Divine Punishment
extDescription: Activate only if The Sanctuary in the Sky is face-up on the field. Negate the activation of an opponent's Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster's effect, and destroy it.

name: Hanewata
extDescription: You can discard this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0. This effect can be activated during either player's turn.

name: Hecatrice
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen from your Deck to your hand.

name: Honest
extDescription: During your Main Phase, you can return this card from the field to its owner's hand. During either player's Damage Step, when a face-up LIGHT monster you control battles, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to have that monster gain ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the End Phase.

name: Marshmallon
extDescription: The controller of a monster that attacks this face-down card takes 1000 damage after damage calculation. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

name: Master Hyperion
extDescription: You can remove from play 1 Agent monster from your side of the field, hand, or Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard to select 1 card on the field and destroy it. If you control a face-up The Sanctuary in the Sky, you can use this effect up to twice per turn.

name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
extDescription: Both players can Normal Summon or Set monsters without Tribute(s) by paying 1000 Life Points x the number of monsters needed to Tribute Summon them.

name: Miraculous Descent
extDescription: Select 1 of your Fairy-Type monsters that is removed from play and Special Summon it. When this card is removed from the field, destroy that monster. When the monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Mystical Shine Ball
extDescription: A soul of light covered by mystical shine. When you see its beautiful shape, your dream will come true.

name: Nova Summoner
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from the Deck. If The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field, you can Special Summon 1 Airknight Parshath instead.

name: Return from the Different Dimension
extDescription: Pay half your Life Points. Special Summon as many of your banished monsters as possible. During the End Phase, remove from play all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.

name: Shining Angel
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard by battle, you can Special Summon 1 LIGHT monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Smashing Ground
extDescription: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the highest DEF. (If it's a tie, you get to choose.)

name: Solemn Judgment
extDescription: Pay half of your Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell Card / Trap Card / Normal Summon / Flip Summon / Special Summon and destroy the Spell Card, Trap Card, or Summoned monster.

name: Solidarity
extDescription: If you have only 1 original (printed) Type of monster in your Graveyard, face-up monsters you control with the same Type gain 800 ATK.

name: Soul of Purity and Light
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard. During your opponent's Battle Phase, monsters they control lose 300 ATK.

name: Splendid Venus
extDescription: All non-Fairy-Type monsters lose 500 ATK and DEF. The activation and effects of your Spell and Trap Cards cannot be negated.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Tethys, Goddess of Light
extDescription: When you draw a Fairy-Type monster(s), you can reveal 1 of those monsters to draw 1 more card.

name: The Agent of Creation - Venus
extDescription: Pay 500 Life Points, select 1 Mystical Shine Ball from your hand or Deck, and Special Summon it to your side of the field.

name: The Agent of Force - Mars
extDescription: This card is unaffected by any Spell Cards. While The Sanctuary in the Sky is on your side of the field, and your Life Points are higher than your opponent's Life Points, increase the ATK and DEF of this card by the difference between your and your opponent's Life Points.

name: The Agent of Judgment - Saturn
extDescription: While your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, you can Tribute this card to inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference. If you do not control The Sanctuary in the Sky, this effect is not applied. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect.

name: The Agent of Miracles - Jupiter
extDescription: Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 Agent monster from your Graveyard to select 1 face-up LIGHT Fairy-Type monster you control. It gains 800 ATK until the End Phase. Once per turn, if The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field, you can discard 1 Fairy-Type monster from your hand to select 1 of your removed from play LIGHT Fairy-Type monsters, and Special Summon it.

name: The Agent of Mystery - Earth
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can add 1 Agent monster from your Deck to your hand, except The Agent of Mystery - Earth. If The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field, you can add 1 Master Hyperion to your hand instead.

name: The Agent of Wisdom - Mercury
extDescription: If you have no cards in your hand at the end of your opponent's End Phase, draw 1 card from your Deck during your next Standby Phase.

name: The Fountain in the Sky
extDescription: When a LIGHT monster is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can remove that monster from play to gain Life Points equal to its ATK.

name: The Sanctuary in the Sky
extDescription: Battle Damage to the controller of a Fairy-Type monster from a battle involving that Fairy-Type monster becomes 0.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: Activate only when a monster is Summoned. Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
extDescription: Once per turn, if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your hand.

name: Victoria
extDescription: Once per turn, you can select and Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your opponent's Graveyard to your side of the field. Your opponent cannot select another face-up Fairy-Type monster as an attack target.

name: Zeradias, Herald of Heaven
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 The Sanctuary in the Sky from your Deck to your hand. If this card is on the field but The Sanctuary in the Sky is not on the field, destroy this card.

name: Lost Sanctuary Structure Deck [1st Edition]
extDescription:
Each Lost Sanctuary Structure Deck contains:
• 1 Preconstructed Deck of 40 cards
• 1 Rulebook
• 1 Dueling Guide
• 1 Playmat
